title: Session and AccountInfo missing Eq derive
description: Session and AccountInfo both derive PartialEq but not Eq. Both types contain HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>; serde_json::Value implements Eq, so Eq is correctly derivable. The omission is inconsistent: WebSocketCapability and ClientConfig both derive Eq. Session and AccountInfo are the primary types consumers will compare in tests and assertions — having PartialEq but not Eq prevents them from being used in HashSet, as HashMap keys, or in contexts that require Eq.
